query:
INSERT INTO attendance (appointmentId, patientId, familyUserId, therapistUserId, therapyType, scheduledDate, status, notes, createdAt, updatedAt)
SELECT 
  a.id,
  a.patientId,
  p.familyUserId,
  a.therapistUserId,
  a.therapyType,
  a.startTime,
  'present',
  'Presença confirmada retroativamente',
  NOW(),
  NOW()
FROM appointments a
LEFT JOIN patients p ON a.patientId = p.id
LEFT JOIN attendance att ON a.id = att.appointmentId
WHERE DATE(a.startTime) = CURDATE()
  AND att.id IS NULL;
